replacesTheThemeS: Replaces the theme's backdrop (“layers” and “spotlight” openings). On the page: hover the opening, then “Change the background”; “Crop” chooses the area that is kept. Empty: the theme's background.
label: Label
usedByThemesWith: Used by themes with a typographic hero. Wrap the word to highlight in '<mark>'…'</mark>' (no other markup). On the page: double-click the sentence, select a word and click “Highlight”.
textBelowTheTitle: Text below the title. Empty: the site's default text (“Scroll”). Can also be edited on the page, along with its typography.
buttonTextThemesWith: Button text (themes with a spotlight hero). Empty: “Demoreel”.
whereTheDemoreelButton: Where the “Demoreel” button leads (themes with a spotlight hero).
anEntryNeverExceeds: An entry never exceeds the screen height: a portrait is scaled down, not cut off.
fixedImagesAreCropped: Fixed: images are cropped to it (on the page, hover an image then click “Crop” to choose the area that is kept).
title: Title
eachEntryShowsA: Each entry shows a large image from the collection and leads to its page. An entry whose page is deleted or unpublished is hidden on the site.
aCollectionEntryShows: A collection entry shows the number of published works and, if no image is chosen, the collection's cover. “None”: a simple page, with the image you choose on the page (required).
tickTheProjectsIn: Tick the projects in the order you want. If you tick none, your “featured” projects are shown.
showsEveryProjectThat: Shows every project that has images in this collection.
aVideoFromYour: A video from your media library; without it, the YouTube demo reel of the Animation collection is shown. The displayed title is its alternative text.
theFormOpensIn: The form opens in a window (or the page scrolls to the form it contains); messages arrive in Admin → Messages. “Open the email” launches the visitor's email app.
aFormToWrite: A form to write to you (fields of your choice) instead of the email button. Messages arrive in Admin → Messages.
fixedThePortraitIs: Fixed: the portrait is cropped to it (on the page, “Crop”).
theSiteNameLarge: The site name, large. Remove it when the page's Opening already shows it.
emptyNoButtonThe: Empty: no button (the email address stays visible, as an email link).
projectNameAndIntroduction: Project name and introduction, at the top
videosFollowTheSame: Videos follow the same format as images.
shortFreeTextFor: Short free text, for example “2026” or “March 2026”.
inAGridThe: In a grid, the image fills its cell.
fixedTheImageIs: Fixed: the image is cropped to it (on the page, hover it then click “Crop” to choose the area that is kept).
withNoFixedFormat: With no fixed format, the image keeps its own. With a format: “Whole image” shows it in full (empty bands if needed), “Fill the cell” crops it. A free crop (“Crop” on the page) follows its own format.
aPdfOfAt: A PDF of at most 10 pages (15 MB): its pages are shown as images, and the button downloads the original PDF.
noExtensionLowercaseLetters: No extension: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (e.g. cv-camille-martin).
reuseAProjectS: Reuse a project's name and introduction
theTitleAndIntroduction: The title and introduction are the project's: you edit them on the page; they also change in the Projects screen and on the page, after publishing.
thePageSBig: The page's big title, at the top: only one per page (the home page opening already is one). A Title inserted at the top of a page with no main title becomes it right away; the others are block titles (h2).
computedFromThePage: Computed from the page's projects, below the title.
emptyInBothLanguages: Empty in both languages: no label. Empty in one language only: that language's default text.
emptyTheLanguageS: Empty: the language's default title (“Page not found”).
aSingleMessageIt: A single message: it is always shown. Several: one message is drawn at random on each visit. A message left empty in one language uses that language's default text.
aPublishedWorkIs: A published work is drawn at random on each visit. Never a draft, a work in the trash, or a project that no page shows.
shownBeforePlaybackOtherwise: Shown before playback; otherwise, the video's own image.
caption: Caption
titleBelowTheVideo: Title below the video (“Video only” presentation)
theAreaSHeight: The area's height follows its width. To shorten or crop it freely, drag the handles on the area's edges and corners, on the page: the images do not move. Choosing a format restores the whole area.
scaledKeepsTheComposition: “Scaled” keeps the composition as it is, only smaller. “Stacked” puts the images in a column, in reading order (top to bottom, then left to right).
yourNameAndYour: Your name and your job title are shared across the whole site (header, profile…): double-click (or double-tap) them on the page to edit them. A menu link is renamed with the “Rename” pencil that appears on it.
oneEntryPerCollection: One entry per collection page (page set to “This page is the collection”), in menu order: adding, removing or unpublishing a page changes the list by itself.
imagesFillTheCells: Images fill the cells in order; beyond that, the pattern repeats. Changing the arrangement removes nothing. Resizing a cell switches to “Custom”.
projectCreatedOnThis: Project created on this page: its name, context and year are edited directly on the page (double-click). It becomes public with the page.
imagesArePlacedMoved: Images are placed, moved and removed directly on the page. The project's name and texts are edited in the Projects screen.
youtubeShotFromThe: YouTube shot from the Animation collection (carried over from the old showcase). Choose a video from your media library to replace it.
nothingYetAddAn: Nothing yet: add an image below, or drag it from the Media tab straight onto the area.
givesEachCellThe: Gives each cell the shape of its image: a portrait over two rows, a panorama over two columns.
onThePageEach: On the page, each cell has “Alone on its row” or “With the others” in its Size menu.
onThePageEach2: On the page, each cell has “Wider”, “Taller”… buttons in its bar.
projectLimitedToThe: Project limited to the works of one discipline (carried over from an old collection page).
thisVideoHasSound: This video has sound: a sound button is shown, on the site as in the Preview.
thisFieldIsUsed: This field is used to reply to you: turn off “Used to reply to you” first.
youChooseTheEntries: You choose the entries, their order and their destination page.
cardVideoTitleAnd: Card: video, title and caption below
videoWithoutSoundNo: Video without sound: no sound button.
exceptTheOnesYou: , except the ones you edited here.
theTitleIntroductionAnd: The title, introduction and images come from the project: editing them here (on the page) also changes them in the Projects screen and elsewhere, after publishing. {count, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}} inside: drag one from “Add” INTO the frame; a project or a title with no project of its own takes this one.
countPlural0No: {count, plural, =0 {No images yet.} one {# image in the grid.} other {# images in the grid.}}
noMailServerOn: (no mail server on this site). Messages arrive in <link>Admin → Messages</link>; your address never appears on the page.
commonImageFormatHelp: All images are cropped the same way, centered. Free: the first image's format.
